headline: Rosie O’Donnell Just Knows Trump Is Watching Her Host ‘Jimmy Kimmel Live’
context: “And if you thought the president hated ‘Jimmy Kimmel Live’ when it was hosted by Jimmy Kimmel, buckle up, people. Buckle up!” O’Donnell said.
